text:
sara: heads-up — we're targeting a staggered cutover tonight in the 23:00 UTC change window for the quant kernel alignment tweak (engine-kernel v3.2.1). plan: canary 5% -> regional ramp -> full. deploybot will coordinate staged rollout.

deploy-bot: @sara scheduled rollout job 3165890000-quant-cutover. timeline: 23:00 5%, 23:30 30%, hold 15m, 23:45 70%, 01:00 100%. preflight smoke passed on staging.

liam: define rollback gates clearly before we start — latency, OOMs, error-rate thresholds?

anh: suggested rollback criteria: p95 latency +20% over baseline within 5m OR token failure rate >0.5% over 10m OR GPU OOMs >0.1% of requests over 10m -> immediate rollback to engine-kernel:3.2.0.

ops-oncall: add KV-cache growth >30% (15m) as a trigger. also plan to bump node-autoscaler min replicas +1 for the first hour after rollout start.

matt: draft release note blurb for docs/sales: "Engine v3.2.1: quant alignment optimization — reduces peak memory for some transformer kernels and can improve throughput on long sequences. Internal tests show gains; older GPU drivers may hit rare mem-pressure edge cases."

sara: keep it high-level and include how to pin back and how to request a hotfix.

anh: rollback/pin command for quick copy:
```
# pin runtime to previous kernel across region
deploybot pin engine-kernel:3.2.0 --scope region --note "rollback: alignment issue"
```

deploy-bot: will create a sticky pin with TTL=6h and will post to ops channel if pin executes.

liam: can we gate with a feature flag so only canary traffic sees QUANT_ALIGN? reduces blast radius during troubleshooting.

sara: yes — enable QUANT_ALIGN_CHECK=true for canary only. config path: /configs/runtime/quant_align/{region}. also attach a small eval prompt set (short-answer responses) to watch for quality regressions before any big ramp.

ops-oncall: I'll add alerts: metrics.agent.p95_token_latency (>20% from baseline), infra.gpu.oom_rate (>0.1% requests), infra.kvcache.size_pct_inc (>30%). Make infra.gpu.oom_rate a P1.

matt: product asks to pause 15m after the 30% ramp to review quality metrics — can we insert a 15m hold at 23:30?

sara: fine. updated rollout: 23:00(5%), 23:30(30%), hold 23:30-23:45, 23:45(70%), 01:00(100%).

deploy-bot: timeline updated for job 3165890000-quant-cutover. I'll post progress updates to #eng-runtime and #oncall at each stage. preflight logs: "smoke: PASS; basic-gen: PASS; kvcache-smoke: PASS".

liam: oncall smoke checklist to copy into runbook: 1) quick sanity gen 2) check kvcache size 3) p95 latency dashboard 4) search driver logs for "misaligned buffer" warnings.

ops-oncall: standing by. if any P1 fires I'll execute pin and notify release manager.

release-manager: I'll handle external comms and notify sales/CS. tag me if we roll back so I can coordinate customer messaging.

sara: owners: deploy-bot runs rollout, ops-oncall owns rollback, liam owns telemetry dashboards, matt owns release notes. I'm primary for on-call coordination and postmortem.

anh: note — buildfarm produced two artifacts: engine-kernel-3.2.1b (safer mem-layout) and 3.2.1a (optimized). we'll use 3.2.1b for canary and only switch to 3.2.1a on broader ramp if metrics look clean.

sara: set canary artifact to 3.2.1b. deploy-bot, please use that for the 5% stage.

deploy-bot: canary artifact set to engine-kernel:3.2.1b for 5% stage; later stages default to 3.2.1a unless pinned.

ops-oncall: tags/checklist for rollout: 
- Slack notifications to #eng-runtime and #oncall at each stage
- Pager rules active for 2h after 100%
- Revert autoscaler bump after 2h

liam: quick check command for OOMs during rollout (quick & dirty):
```
kubectl logs -l app=runtime -n prod | grep -c "GPU OOM"
```

sara: I'll post a short heads-up in #eng-runtime 30m before the change. deploy-bot, start at 23:00 UTC unless objections in next 20m.

matt: :thumbsup: product ok with schedule.

ops-oncall: :ok_hand: on-call and ready to execute pin.

liam: watching dashboards.

release-manager: standing by for comms if rollback happens.

sara: rolling in T-20m. ping immediately for urgent issues.

deploy-bot: commencing canary in 15m.

sara: copy of rollback criteria for quick reference: p95 +20% (5m), token fail rate >0.5% (10m), GPU OOMs >0.1% (10m), KV-cache >30% (15m). any trigger -> pin engine-kernel:3.2.0 and escalate.

ops-oncall: acknowledged. I'll own rollback if needed.

matt: thanks team. :shipit:
